skill_name: Write a 70 word article on the importance of data security
workflow: Data security is an essential part of any business, especially in the digital age. With the increasing use of digital services and assets, it is essential for organizations to ensure their data is secure. Data security provides businesses with protection from unauthorized access, loss, or corruption of sensitive and confidential data.
